teaser.en: A silvery wild bean that sprawls across the ground just like a sweet-potato vine.
teaser.sw: Kunde-pori wa rangi ya fedha anayetambaa ardhini kama mtambaa wa kiazi kitamu.
teaser.dg: Mmea wa weruni wa jamii ya kunde, wa rangi ya feza, unaoambala photsi dza vira muyogbwe unavyoambala.

summary.en: Yogweyogwe is a trailing wild bean of coastal grassland and farmland, with leaves silvery underneath. Its name compares the way it spreads to a sweet potato.
summary.sw: Yogweyogwe ni kunde-pori anayetambaa katika nyika na mashamba ya pwani, mwenye majani yenye rangi ya fedha upande wa chini. Jina lake linalinganisha jinsi unavyoenea na kiazi kitamu.
summary.dg: *Yogweyogwe* ni mmea wa weruni wa jamii ya kunde unaoambala photsi, unaomera phatu phenye nyasi na kpwenye minda ya pwani, na makodzage ni ga rangi ya feza photsi. Dzinare rinaringanisha vira unavyoambala na muyogbwe.

about.en:
*Yogweyogwe* is a perennial herb of the bean family that trails along the ground or scrambles up other plants. Its leaves have three broad, sometimes three-lobed leaflets, sparsely hairy above and densely silvery-hairy underneath, and the stems are rough with rusty hairs.

The pea-shaped flowers are white or pink, followed by short, oblong pods covered in dark brown bristly hairs.
about.sw:
*Yogweyogwe* ni mmea wa kudumu wa jamii ya kunde unaotambaa ardhini au kupanda juu ya mimea mingine. Majani yake yana vijani vitatu vipana, wakati mwingine vyenye ndewe tatu, vyenye manyoya machache upande wa juu na manyoya mengi ya rangi ya fedha upande wa chini, na mashina ni makwaruzo kwa manyoya ya rangi ya kutu.

Maua yenye umbo la ua la njegere ni meupe au ya waridi, yakifuatwa na maganda mafupi marefu kiasi yaliyofunikwa na manyoya magumu ya kahawia iliyokolea.
about.dg:
*Yogweyogwe* ni mmea wa jamii ya kunde unaokala miaka minji, unaoambala photsi au unaokpwera dzulu ya mimea yanjina. Chila kodza rina makodza madide mahahu mapana, na wakati wanjina chila kodza dide rina mala mahahu; dzulu gana nyere chache, na photsi gana nyere nyinji za rangi ya feza. Mihiye ni ya kukaraza, na ina nyere za rangi ya dongo na kundu.

Maruwa, ga umbo dza maruwa ga kunde, ni mereru au ga pinki, na badaye kunatuluka makakaya mafupi ga mviringo mure, genye nyere ngumu za rangi ya dongo iriyo phephi na nyiru.

where.en: It grows in coastal grassland and farmland close to sea level, from south-east Kenya to Mozambique, with a separate population in West Africa.
where.sw: Hukua katika nyika na mashamba ya pwani karibu na usawa wa bahari, kutoka kusini-mashariki mwa Kenya hadi Msumbiji, na kundi jingine tofauti Afrika Magharibi.
where.dg: Unamera phatu phenye nyasi na kpwenye minda ya pwani, phatu phasiphokala dzulu kula bahari, kula kusini-mashariki ya Kenya hadi Mozambique, na kuna mimea yanjina ya aina hino kure, Afrika ya Magharibi.

names.en: Pakia records *yogweyogwe*, named after the sweet potato, *myogwe*, because it spreads across the ground the same way. The repetition in the name means 'in the manner of': a plant that behaves like a sweet potato. No English or Swahili name is recorded.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *yogweyogwe*, lililopewa jina kutokana na kiazi kitamu, *myogwe*, kwa sababu huenea ardhini kwa njia ileile. Kurudiwa kwa neno katika jina kunamaanisha 'kwa namna ya': mmea unaotenda kama kiazi kitamu. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *yogweyogwe*, dzina ririrohalwa kula muyogbwe, *myogwe*, kpwa sababu unaambala photsi vivyo. Neno *yogwe* kugombwa mara mbiri kpwenye dzina kunamaanisha 'kpwa njira ya': mmea unaohenda dza muyogbwe. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa.

reason.en: the sweet potato it is named after
reason.sw: kiazi kitamu ambacho limepewa jina kutokana nacho
reason.dg: muyogbwe, ambao mmea huno uriphewa dzinare kula kpwakpwe
